controle: Step log: mention of the rerun and its reason.
regle: When delegation to agents gives insufficient results (disagreements between judges, repeated errors, a failing check), I can take the work back myself, without asking for agreement again, recording it in the step log.
source: The user's message (2026-10-16): "If splitting up the work does not give good results. I authorise you to do the work yourself."
titre: Delegated work inconclusive: do it yourself
